page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Gathering signature at the foot right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: sanctio, & sanctorum Patrum qui Nicææ congregati sunt, regula : nimirum ut Antistites una cum finitimis (modo ipsis visum fuerit) Episcopis, prout utile judicaverint, ordinationes faciantin suis ipsorū provin-ciis;Per antiquam illam sanctionem designari opinatur Beveregius Can. Apost. xiv. & xv. quod nulla Synodo Nicænâ, si illum audimus, antiquior lex extitit quæ hoc con-stituit, præter Canones illos Apostolicos. At quam vana sit ac frivola eruditi Viri ra-tiocinatio, pluribus demonstratum imus, 1. Defignati Canones nihil plane dicunt de Episcoporum ordinationibus, de quibus expresse agitur in testimonio allato, ut cuivis legenti patet; unde liquet, ut id obiter notem, ad fictitios istos Canones minime confugiendum esse, quoties apud Veteres fit mentio alicujus sanctionis antiquæ quæ in genuinis quos habemus Conciliorum Canonibus hodie non extat, plures siquidem ejusmodi sanctiones usu & consuetudine obtinuêre, quæ tamen litteris statim traditæ non fuêre. 2. Si tunc tempo-ris extitissent prædicti Canones, & ad eos respexissent Synodi Constantinopolitanæ Patres, plusquam verisimile est eos hanc Canonum collectionem memoraturos esse æquè ac Nicænorum Patrum regulam, vel saltem Canones ipsos suis numeris indica-

page.notes: Printed at the head: "Beveregii in Can. Apost." and page number "11", the second numeral partly blurred, so the number is marked [?]. Page ends mid-word at "indica-", kept as printed. Small ink blot over "non extat" and smudges near "Canonibus"; the words are readable. Long s rendered as s throughout; ct ligatures rendered as plain letters. Gathering signature "B ij" at the foot right.
